2.	Model performance measurement page (very simple dashboard with results)

4.	Training data hosted on cloud

•	Scaling of the ASR project

It should retrieve and display relevant PDF documents (url to pdf) or web pages (url to web [ages) based on the user's input.
AWS Hosting and Demo
